source_text: I re-minted codex-18 and asked it to state its model type but it can't, is it on Sol or Astra?

fragments.text: I re-minted codex-18 and asked it to state its model type but it can't, is it on Sol or Astra?

reply_text:
㊥ (codex-18's model) It's on Sol. The new codex-18 session, minted at 13:55 today, records `"model":"gpt-5.6-sol"` in every turn context written so far: 6 of 6 entries. That matches `~/.codex/config.toml`, which sets `model = "gpt-5.6-sol"`. The old codex-18 was on Astra because its session started on 2 October with a different setting, not because of the current config.

㊬ (how I checked)
- I took codex-18's current session id from Agency (`01a10732-979d-…`).
- I found its Codex log, `~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/04/rollout-2026-10-04T13-55-18-01a10732….jsonl`.
- I counted the `"model"` fields in it.

That's the same evidence claude-2 used to spot the Astra sessions.

㊟ (why it can't say) The model name isn't in its context unless the harness puts it there, so asking an agent to state its own model is unreliable. The session log is the record.
